notes: The clause is verbless, so the supplied *He appointed* is added under rule 20 and the appositional *to wit* is added under rule 16, no marker standing on the phrase it introduces.
The waw s001 already carries *also* (rule 51), so nothing licenses the supplied verb.
*new moons* heads on *new* and *set feasts* on *feasts* by rule 31's ASV-usage test: the ASV writes *feasts* alone for מוֹעֵד but never *moons* alone for חֹדֶשׁ.
